title: Can LVLMs Uncover the Truth Behind Visual Illusions? An Analysis of Perceptual and Reasoning Capabilities
abstract: arXiv:2607.27747v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Vision Language Models have integrated reasoning capabilities, elevating cognitive performance to new levels. However, existing evaluations either focus solely on perception or rely on specific domains such as maths or coding. Evaluation for reasoning capabilities that align with an open-world environment is still required, especially one that considers perception and reasoning jointly. To bridge this gap, we propose to evaluate LVLMs by exploiting visual illusions as a diagnostic tool. Visual illusions are phenomena in which the human visual system misinterprets objective signals, resulting in an understanding that deviates from reality. We constructed Illusion-Reasoning, a benchmark of illusion images collected from the real world, incorporating diverse annotated question-answer pairs. translated_title: 大型视觉语言模型能否揭示视觉错觉背后的真相？对感知与推理能力的分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.27747v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：大型视觉语言模型已整合了推理能力，将认知性能提升至新水平。然而，现有评估要么仅关注感知，要么依赖特定领域如数学或编程。仍需要与开放世界环境对齐的推理能力评估，尤其是考虑感知与推理联合的评估。为弥合这一差距，我们提出利用视觉错觉作为诊断工具来评估LVLMs。视觉错觉是人类视觉系统误解客观信号的现象，导致理解偏离现实。我们构建了Illusion-Reasoning，一个从现实世界收集的错觉图像基准，包含多样化的标注问答对。基于Illusion-Reasoning，我们表明多种LVLMs的推理能力并不如声称的那样先进。我们的工作揭示了这些模型在感知与推理协同上的局限性。
tldr: 通过构建基于真实视觉错觉图像的基准测试，发现大型视觉语言模型在联合感知与推理方面能力有限，远未达到其宣称的先进水平。
en_tdlr: By constructing a benchmark based on real-world visual illusion images, we reveal that large vision-language models have limited capabilities in jointly perceiving and reasoning, far from their claimed advanced performance.
